== Description ==
The October 2023 printable slip for [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle (V)]]. The same card text appears on the Players Committee's full card image.

== Source and credit ==
Players Committee [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet], p. 1, slip “•Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle”. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114020627id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Internet Archive].
